title: RM-BENCH: BENCHMARKING REWARD MODELS OF LANGUAGE MODELS WITH SUBTLETY AND STYLE

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating reward models using a Style-Substance Evaluation Matrix that pairs factually correct and incorrect responses across three controlled stylistic variations (concise, detailed plain text, detailed with Markdown formatting) to measure if the models spuriously prefer verbose or well-formatted text over substantive correctness.
